original_description:
Falcon Herbs presents 70g of pure, sun-dried Neem leaves — carefully harvested and air-dried to preserve their natural integrity. Sourced from trusted Ayurvedic groves, these leaves are a time-honored part of traditional wellness rituals in India. Neem has long been valued in Ayurvedic practice for its distinctive aroma, cleansing qualities, and deep-rooted connection to holistic self-care routines.

Use Neem leaves to prepare herbal infusions, natural face packs, hair rinses, or as part of your daily self-care rituals. Their earthy fragrance and textured form make them ideal for DIY Ayurvedic preparations at home.

Traditional Uses of Neem Leaves

  • Used in herbal pastes for skin care routines
  • Added to bath water for a refreshing, natural experience
  • Blended into hair rinses as part of scalp care traditions
  • Integrated into home-based wellness rituals for daily renewal

Neem Leaves in Hair Care Traditions

  • Used in herbal rinses for scalp comfort
  • Part of traditional hair cleansing practices
  • Valued for its natural texture in herbal hair treatments
  • Commonly included in DIY hair masks for nourishing rituals

Each 70g pack contains 100% pure, organic Neem leaves — no additives, no preservatives, no artificial processing. Store in a cool, dry place. Ideal for those who appreciate authentic Ayurvedic ingredients in their daily rituals.

Perfect for: Ayurvedic enthusiasts | DIY herbal crafters | Natural skincare lovers | Home ritual practitioners
